name: 雷神
scope: Medium generation specification only; parent submits API calls and separately reviews actual output. No runtime or readiness change.

source.text: 雷澤中有雷神，龍身而人頭，鼓其腹。在吳西。

sourceVerification.basis: Research commit content and provenance; 2026-11-08 fresh WebFetch of 海內東經 confirms the complete short entry and absence of specified arms/tools.
sourceVerification.editionNote: Research commit separately records Gutenberg 龍首而人頭 as a transcription difference. Selected Wikisource/Siku reading is 龍身而人頭; do not silently combine into two heads.
boundaries: 龍身而人頭 must not become a human body with a dragon head.
鼓其腹 is explicit; paired arms, hands striking, belly-pulse mechanics and a separate thunder-result clause are not specified.
No drum, mallets, bird beak, wings, horns, four claws, spring season or purple lightning is established by the selected text.
在吳西 ends the short entry; subsequent 都州 and annotation references are separate.

inferred.item: One human head on an elongated scaled dragon body with a full upper abdomen
inferred.basis: Head/body identity and 鼓其腹 are explicit. Complete cranium, neck integration, scales, rounded belly volume, long circular trunk and tapered tail are artistic anatomy choices.

inferred.item: No arms or other limbs, no horns or wings
inferred.basis: Minimal production choice; no limb count is supplied by the source. Do not add hands merely to force the old catalog's paired-arm action.

inferred.item: Abdominal rhythmic expansion for a possible later 鼓腹 interpretation
inferred.basis: This is an explicit inferred motion option, not a literal claim that 鼓其腹 specifies inflation or excludes striking. Body geometry leaves the belly visible and deformable. Thunder timing and sound remain future artistic design.

inferred.item: Blue-green scales, pale scutes and open shallow-S pose
inferred.basis: Color, proportions and pose are not stated by the source. No baked lightning or clouds in the model.

jobs.role: One complete continuous human-headed dragon including a clearly visible organic abdomen and pointed tail

currentModel.evidence: Research commit and provenance are source/blocker work. Existing isolated human-head/tail evidence does not establish a complete dragon-body master or accepted Leishen; no new model or fresh inventory audit is claimed.

acceptance: Read four actual orthographic views and human neck/abdomen/tail closeups independently before any High decision.
Human head with complete cranium and natural throat integration, unmistakable long scaled dragon body; no dragon head, human torso, bird beak, floating bust or pasted collar.
Rounded abdomen is part of the continuous trunk, not a separate ball, external drum or inflated isolated tail; belly must remain visible and suited to conservative deformation.
Complete extended shallow S with head and pointed tail separated, no ring, coil, ouroboros, crossings, self-welding or missing tip.
No native arms, tools, horns or wings in this selected design; no base or baked effects concealing roots.

Later production must verify belly deformation and finite skinning, full-body clearance or actual belly contacts, three-state and continuous Read captures, StrictMode lifecycle, audio inference and special return. No current model QA pass is claimed.
